questions.q: How would you describe the apostles' conviction, and do you agree with it?
questions.answer: They were so sure they'd seen Jesus alive that threats couldn't stop them; they couldn't stop telling what they'd seen and heard. I agree, because nobody dies for a lie.

questions.q: If you knew something was true, how far would you go to make it known?
questions.answer: One honest answer: "If I'd really seen it myself, I'd keep telling people even if it cost me friends, like the apostles kept talking after they were threatened."

questions.q: What does the apostles' fate mean for your own faith, here and now?
questions.answer: They saw Jesus with their own eyes and chose suffering over denying it, so I can trust their message. It pushes me to live my faith outside youth group too, not just at camp.
